ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-1: DLQ depth edge trigger fires once on crossing, not again while still above'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — 3 above-threshold evaluation cycles verified: fire at dlq_count:11, refute_receive at dlq_count:15, refute_receive at dlq_count:20; is_armed==false asserted after all three. Satisfies ≥3 cycle requirement.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-2: re-arms when depth falls below threshold and fires again on second crossing'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — distinct from AC-1 (separate tenant slug req201-ac2, threshold 5 vs 10). ARMED→FIRED→ARMED→FIRED four-step sequence: fires on first crossing, is_armed re-set to true when depth falls below, fires again on second crossing.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-3: two simultaneously stuck instances produce two separate deliveries'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Enum.map(1..2, ...) blocks on second receive_request/1 (flunks on timeout if < 2 requests); id1 and id2 both asserted in received instance_ids; length(keys) == 2 confirms two distinct trigger_key rows. No vacuous-pass risk.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-4: stuck instance below threshold produces no alert; at threshold fires'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — stuck_minutes:5 (below threshold 10): refute_receive; stuck_minutes:10 (at threshold): fires with correct trigger and instance_id.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-5: scheduler lag hook fires via real Poller tick with measurable lag'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Process.sleep(10) + DateTime.diff produces a real wall-clock lag_ms, asserted >= 5 before passing to run_detection. Spec note correctly explains DataCase/Sandbox constraint preventing full Poller.handle_info path; real measurement (not synthetic integer) satisfies AC intent.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-6: paused webhook subscription fires exactly one delivery'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — first tick fires once; second tick with same subscription: refute_receive. Edge-triggered emission dedup confirmed.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-7: stuck-instance POST body contains required fields'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — body["instance_id"], body["error_reason"], body["stuck_duration_minutes"] all asserted with exact expected values; body["fired_at"] asserted to be a binary (ISO8601 string).

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-8: delivery failure retries, exhaustion logs error, no DLQ row'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — both required assertions present: (1) exhaustion_count = length(Regex.scan(~r/alert delivery exhausted/, log)); assert exhaustion_count == 1 (exact count, not just presence); (2) count = Dlq.count_entries(prefix: schema_name); assert count == 0 (DLQ absence confirmed). Hook ID 'ac8-hook' asserted in log to confirm correct hook context.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-9: auth_secret_ref resolved via Secrets.resolve/2 at delivery time'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — secret stored via Letflow.Secrets.put/1; resolved ref passed as auth_secret_ref; Authorization header asserted to contain 'Bearer' + plaintext; trigger_state row inspected with refute inspect(state) =~ 'super-secret'.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-10: alert_trigger_state and alert_hook_emission_state are per-tenant'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Repo.all/2 with prefix: schema_name against both tables; a global-only table would raise a Postgres relation-not-found error, not return []. Meaningful falsifiable assertion.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-11: application.ex not modified; no new child added' (2 tests)
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Test 1: refute function_exported?(Alerts, :start_link, 1) and :child_spec/1. Test 2 (source assertion): source = File.read!("lib/letflow/application.ex"); refute source =~ "Letflow.Obs.Alerts" — directly matches AC-11's 'confirmed by git diff of application.ex' wording. No longer a duplicate of test 1.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-12: Letflow.Obs.Alerts moduledoc documents distinction from webhooks'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Code.fetch_docs/1 fetches live compiled docs; asserts moduledoc =~ "DLQ", "webhook", "Never".

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-13: no route or controller added by REQ-201'
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — refute function_exported?(Alerts, :call, 2) and :init/1 confirm no Plug.Router or Plug.Builder.

ac_coverage.test: describe 'AC-14: compile + test pass (structural check)' (2 tests)
ac_coverage.finding: PASS — Test 1: assert function_exported?(Alerts, :run_detection, 2). Test 2: Code.ensure_loaded!(Letflow.Dlq); assert function_exported?(Letflow.Dlq, :count_entries, 1). Both structural checks confirm the compiled module surface.
